title: Conectores y redacción profesional (however, therefore)
goal: Al terminar podrás unir ideas con el conector correcto para añadir, contrastar, dar causas, resultados y secuencias; puntuar however y therefore sin errores, y escribir en 15 minutos un correo profesional completo, claro y cortés, como lo haría un ingeniero nativo.

lesson.title: Los conectores: señales de tránsito
lesson.html:
Los conectores son las señales de tránsito de un texto: le dicen al lector hacia dónde va la próxima idea. However avisa "viene un giro", therefore avisa "viene la consecuencia". Sin ellos, un correo es una lista de datos sueltos; con el conector equivocado, el lector entiende lo contrario de lo que querías decir.

El español escrito tolera oraciones largas unidas con comas y con "y". El inglés profesional prefiere oraciones cortas, una idea por oración, y un conector preciso al inicio de cada oración. Por eso un correo traducido palabra por palabra del español se siente pesado y confuso para un lector nativo, aunque cada palabra esté bien.

lesson.title: Cuatro tipos de conector
lesson.html:
El error más caro no es elegir mal el significado, sino la gramática del conector. Hay cuatro familias y cada una exige algo distinto después:

TipoEjemplosQué va despuésPuntuaciónEjemplo
Conjunciónand, but, so, or, yetOración completaComa antes (en oraciones largas)The test passed, but the report is late.
Subordinantealthough, because, since, while, whereas, as soon asOración (sujeto + verbo)Coma si va al inicio (whereas: coma siempre)Although it rained, we finished.
Adverbio conectorhowever, therefore, moreover, as a result, in additionOración nuevaPunto o punto y coma antes; coma despuésThe test passed. However, the report is late.
Preposicióndespite, in spite of, because of, due to, owing toSustantivo o verbo en -ingComa si va al inicioDespite the rain, we finished.

lesson.title: Las tres reglas de oro
lesson.html:
Regla de oro 1 — However y therefore no unen oraciones con coma

Son adverbios, no conjunciones. Necesitan punto o punto y coma antes, y coma después.

The weld was rejected. However, we repaired it the same day.
The weld was rejected; however, we repaired it the same day.
Nunca The weld was rejected, however we repaired it.

Regla de oro 2 — Oración o sustantivo: mira qué viene después

  • Oración (sujeto + verbo) → because, although, even though: because the truck broke down.
  • Sustantivo o -ing → because of, due to, despite, in spite of: because of the breakdown, despite working late.

Regla de oro 3 — Una relación, un conector

En español se dice "aunque…, pero…" o "como…, entonces…". En inglés cada relación lleva un solo conector.

Although the tank is old, it is safe.   Nunca Although the tank is old, but it is safe.
Because it rained, we stopped.   Nunca Because it rained, so we stopped.

lesson.title: Así piensa un nativo
lesson.html:
Así piensa un nativo — primero la idea, luego el conector como señal

Un lector profesional en inglés lee rápido y espera la idea principal al inicio (los estadounidenses lo llaman bottom line up front). Cada oración siguiente empieza con un conector que anuncia su función: As a result, … However, … In addition, …. Al hablar, el nativo usa los conectores cortos (so, but, also) y pone though al final: It's expensive. It works well, though. its ek-SPÉN-siv. it werks WEL, dhou

lesson.title: Traducción directa vs inglés real
lesson.html:
Cómo lo escribiríamos en español
La bomba se detuvo y la revisamos y el sello estaba dañado y no teníamos repuesto, así que pedimos uno que llega mañana, por lo que la línea sigue parada.

Cómo lo escribe un nativo
The pump stopped at 10:30 a.m. During the inspection, we found a damaged mechanical seal. Since we did not have a spare on site, we ordered one from Houston. As a result, the line will remain down until the part arrives tomorrow.

EspañolTraducción literal (mal)Inglés real
Sin embargo, …Without embargo, …However, …
A pesar de que llovió, …Despite that it rained, …Although it rained, … / Despite the rain, …
Debido a que se malogró el camión, …Due to the truck broke down, …Because the truck broke down, …
Por otro lado, …By the other side, …On the other hand, …
En cambio, el modelo nuevo…In change, the new model…By contrast, the new model… / …, whereas the new model…
Al final elegimos la opción B.At the end we chose option B.In the end, we chose option B.
Actualmente trabajo en Chile.Actually I work in Chile.Currently, I work in Chile.
Adjunto el informe.I attach you the report.Please find the report attached. / I have attached the report.
Quedo atento a sus comentarios.I stay attentive to your comments.I look forward to your comments.

lesson.title: Afirmativo, negativo y pregunta
lesson.html:
El conector no cambia la gramática del verbo: cada oración se niega y se pregunta con su auxiliar normal (Módulos 3–13). Lo que cambia es el sentido, así que revisa que la lógica siga teniendo sentido.

EstructuraEjemplo
AfirmativoOración + conector + oraciónWe replaced the valve because it was leaking.
NegativoSe niega el verbo de la oración que correspondeWe didn't replace the valve because it wasn't leaking.
PreguntaAuxiliar + sujeto + verbo + conector + oraciónDid you replace the valve because it was leaking?
Respuesta cortaYes / No + sujeto + auxiliarYes, we did. / No, we didn't.

lesson.title: Detalles que marcan la diferencia
lesson.html:
Detalles que marcan la diferencia

  • However puede ir al inicio (lo más claro), en medio entre comas (The price, however, is high.) o al final (The price is high, however.).
  • Since y while tienen dos sentidos: since = desde / ya que; while = mientras / mientras que. El contexto decide.
  • So = por eso (resultado). So that = para que (propósito): We added screens so that the wind doesn't affect the welds.
  • Due to es más formal que because of y queda muy natural después de be: The delay was due to the rain.
  • Al responder una pregunta con Why? se puede decir Because it rained., pero en un correo escribe la oración completa: We stopped because it rained.

rows: The pump failed because of the heat.
The pump didn't fail because of the heat.
Did the pump fail because of the heat?
Yes, it did. / No, it didn't.
She was late due to the traffic.
She wasn't late due to the traffic.
Was she late due to the traffic?
Yes, she was. / No, she wasn't.
They'll start as soon as the permit arrives.
They won't start until the permit arrives.
Will they start as soon as the permit arrives?
Yes, they will. / No, they won't.
We replaced the valve because it was leaking.
We didn't replace the valve because it wasn't leaking.
Did you replace the valve because it was leaking?
Yes, we did. / No, we didn't.
Mark has approved the drawings; therefore, we can order the steel.
Mark hasn't approved the drawings; therefore, we can't order the steel.
Has Mark approved the drawings?
Yes, he has. / No, he hasn't.
The crane is available, so we're lifting the roof today.
The crane isn't available, so we aren't lifting the roof today.
Are we lifting the roof today?
Yes, we are. / No, we aren't.
Ana sent the report after the meeting.
Ana didn't send the report after the meeting.
Did Ana send the report after the meeting?
Yes, she did. / No, she didn't.
We finished on time despite the rain.
We didn't finish on time despite the extra welders.
Did you finish on time despite the rain?
Yes, we did. / No, we didn't.

dialog.text: Sarah, do you have a minute? Could you check this email before I send it to the client?
Sure. Let me see… It's clear, but this first sentence is too long. You use "and" five times.
You're right. I wrote it the way I would write it in Spanish.
Split it in two. End the first sentence after "postponed," and then start the second one with "As a result."
OK. And here, is "however" correct after a comma?
Not really. Put a period or a semicolon before "however" and a comma after it.
Got it. What about "despite of the rain"?
Just "despite the rain," with no "of." Or you can say "in spite of the rain."
Thanks. Should I end with "I stay attentive to your comments"?
No, that's a direct translation. Write "I look forward to hearing from you" or "Please let me know if you have any questions."
Perfect. I'll fix it and send it before lunch.

errors.wrong: The test failed, however we repeated it.
errors.right: The test failed; however, we repeated it.
errors.why: However es adverbio: punto o punto y coma antes, coma después.

errors.right: Despite the rain, … / In spite of the rain, …
errors.why: Despite nunca lleva of; in spite siempre lo lleva.

errors.wrong: Although it's old, but it works.
We stopped because of it was late.
errors.right: We stopped because it was late.
errors.why: Because of va con sustantivo; con oración, solo because.

errors.wrong: Due to the truck broke down, …
errors.right: Because the truck broke down, … / Due to a breakdown, …
errors.why: Due to es preposición: necesita sustantivo.
La expresión fija es on the other hand.

errors.wrong: At the end, we chose option B.
errors.right: In the end, we chose option B.
errors.why: In the end = finalmente; at the end of = al final de algo (at the end of the month).

errors.wrong: Actually, I work in Chile. (= actualmente)
The valve was damaged, so that we replaced it.
errors.right: The valve was damaged, so we replaced it.
errors.why: So = resultado; so that = propósito (para que).

errors.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
errors.right: I look forward to hearing from you.
errors.why: En look forward to, to es preposición: va -ing (Módulo 22).

A1.prompt: Sin embargo, el cliente no aprobó el presupuesto.
answers: However, the client did not approve the budget.
However, the client didn't approve the budget.
A1.explain: Sin embargo al inicio = However + coma. Registro formal: did not.

A1.prompt: La prueba hidrostática se retrasó debido a la lluvia.
answers: The hydrostatic test was delayed due to the rain.
The hydrostatic test was delayed because of the rain.
The hydrostatic test was delayed due to rain.
A1.explain: Pasiva (Módulo 20) + due to + sustantivo. También vale because of the rain.

A1.prompt: Aunque el tanque es antiguo, el fondo está en buen estado.
answers: Although the tank is old, the bottom is in good condition.
Even though the tank is old, the bottom is in good condition.
Although the tank is old, the floor is in good condition.
A1.explain: Although + oración, coma, oración principal. Sin but. También vale Even though.

A1.prompt: La válvula tenía una fuga; por lo tanto, cerramos la línea.
answers: The valve had a leak; therefore, we closed the line.
The valve was leaking; therefore, we closed the line.
The valve had a leak. Therefore, we closed the line.
The valve was leaking. Therefore, we closed the line.
A1.explain: Punto y coma antes de therefore, coma después. También vale The valve was leaking.

A1.prompt: A pesar del calor, el equipo terminó la soldadura a tiempo.
answers: Despite the heat, the team finished the welding on time.
In spite of the heat, the team finished the welding on time.
Despite the heat, the team finished welding on time.
A1.explain: Despite + sustantivo, sin of. También vale In spite of the heat.

answers: In addition, we need two more welders.
Moreover, we need two more welders.
Furthermore, we need two more welders.
A1.explain: Conector formal al inicio + coma. También vale Moreover o Furthermore. Orden: two more welders, no two welders more.

A1.prompt: Adjunto encontrará el informe de inspección.
answers: Please find attached the inspection report.
Please find the inspection report attached.
I have attached the inspection report.
A1.explain: Fórmula fija de correo. También vale Please find the inspection report attached o I have attached the inspection report.

answers: I look forward to hearing from you.

A1.prompt: Primero revisamos los planos y luego visitamos la obra.
answers: First, we reviewed the drawings, and then we visited the site.
First, we reviewed the drawings and then we visited the site.
First, we reviewed the drawings. Then, we visited the site.
First, we reviewed the drawings, and then visited the site.
First we reviewed the drawings and then we visited the site.
A1.explain: Secuencia con First y then. "Obra" (lugar) = the site.

A1.prompt: Como el material no llegó, no pudimos empezar.
answers: Since the material did not arrive, we could not start.
As the material did not arrive, we could not start.
Because the material did not arrive, we could not start.
Since the material didn't arrive, we couldn't start.
As the material didn't arrive, we couldn't start.
Because the material didn't arrive, we couldn't start.
A1.explain: "Como" causal = Since o As, nunca Like. También vale Because the material…

A2.prompt: The crane was not available; as a result, the lift was postponed until Monday.
answers: La grúa no estaba disponible; como resultado, el izaje se postergó hasta el lunes.
La grúa no estaba disponible; en consecuencia, el izaje se postergó hasta el lunes.
La grúa no estaba disponible; como resultado, el izaje se pospuso hasta el lunes.
La grúa no estaba disponible, por lo que el izaje se postergó hasta el lunes.
A2.explain: As a result = como resultado / en consecuencia. Lift = izaje.

A2.prompt: Whereas the old pump used 15 kW, the new one uses only 9 kW.
answers: Mientras que la bomba antigua consumía 15 kW, la nueva consume solo 9 kW.
Mientras que la bomba vieja consumía 15 kW, la nueva consume solo 9 kW.
Mientras la bomba antigua usaba 15 kW, la nueva usa solo 9 kW.
A2.explain: Whereas compara dos datos = mientras que. Use con energía = consumir.

A2.prompt: Could you please confirm the delivery date by Friday?
answers: ¿Podría confirmar la fecha de entrega a más tardar el viernes, por favor?
¿Podría confirmar, por favor, la fecha de entrega a más tardar el viernes?
¿Podría por favor confirmar la fecha de entrega antes del viernes?
A2.explain: Could you please = pedido cortés. By Friday = a más tardar el viernes, no "por el viernes".

A2.prompt: Even though we followed the procedure, the weld failed the X-ray test.
answers: Aunque seguimos el procedimiento, la soldadura no pasó la radiografía.
Aun cuando seguimos el procedimiento, la soldadura no pasó la radiografía.
A pesar de que seguimos el procedimiento, la soldadura no pasó la prueba de rayos X.
A2.explain: Even though = aunque (enfático). Fail a test = no pasar / reprobar una prueba.

A2.prompt: Actually, the meeting is tomorrow, not today.
answers: En realidad, la reunión es mañana, no hoy.
De hecho, la reunión es mañana, no hoy.
A2.explain: Actually = en realidad (corrige un dato). No significa "actualmente".

B.prompt: Despite of the delay, we finished the project on budget.
answers: Despite the delay, we finished the project on budget.
In spite of the delay, we finished the project on budget.
B.explain: Despite no lleva of (o bien In spite of the delay).

B.prompt: The weld was rejected, however we repaired it the same day.
answers: The weld was rejected; however, we repaired it the same day.
The weld was rejected. However, we repaired it the same day.
B.explain: Comma splice: however necesita punto o punto y coma antes y coma después.

B.prompt: Although the client was happy, but he asked for a discount.
answers: Although the client was happy, he asked for a discount.
B.explain: Sobra but: un solo conector de contraste.

B.prompt: We stopped the work because of it was raining.
answers: We stopped the work because it was raining.
B.explain: Con oración se usa because, no because of.

B.prompt: In the other hand, the new design is cheaper.
answers: On the other hand, the new design is cheaper.
B.explain: La expresión fija es on the other hand.

B.prompt: Due to the pump failed, the whole line stopped.
answers: Because the pump failed, the whole line stopped.
Due to the pump failure, the whole line stopped.
B.explain: Due to no va con oración. También vale Due to the pump failure, …

B.prompt: I look forward to hear from you soon.
answers: I look forward to hearing from you soon.

B.prompt: Moreover the tank is old, it is still in service.
answers: Although the tank is old, it is still in service.
Even though the tank is old, it is still in service.
Although the tank is old, it's still in service.
Even though the tank is old, it's still in service.
B.explain: Moreover añade; aquí hay contraste → Although (o Even though).

B.prompt: The valve was damaged, so that we replaced it.
answers: The valve was damaged, so we replaced it.
B.explain: So that expresa propósito; para resultado, solo so.

B.prompt: We will start the test as soon as the inspector will arrive.
answers: We will start the test as soon as the inspector arrives.
We'll start the test as soon as the inspector arrives.
B.explain: Después de as soon as (tiempo futuro) va presente simple, no will.

bonus.prompt: une estas dos oraciones de tres formas (con because, con therefore y con due to): The gauge was broken. We postponed the test.
bonus.answer: We postponed the test because the gauge was broken. / The gauge was broken; therefore, we postponed the test. / We postponed the test due to the broken gauge.

C1.instructions: Completa el diálogo con estos conectores; usa cada uno una vez (8 puntos): however · because of · therefore · although · in addition · as soon as · first · finally.

lines.text: How is the T-210 floor repair going?
[1], the good news: all the new plates are welded. [2], the vacuum box test showed two small leaks.
Mostly [3] the wind yesterday. The shielding gas wasn't stable.
I see. [4] it's a small problem, we need to report it.
I agree. [5], I'm writing a nonconformance report today. [6], we'll put up wind screens around the welders.
[7] the repairs are done, probably tomorrow morning.
Good. And [8], please send me the photos before you leave.

answers: First
blanks.explain: Ordena lo que va a decir: First, the good news.

answers: However
blanks.explain: Giro negativo tras la buena noticia; adverbio al inicio + coma.

answers: because of
blanks.explain: Va seguido de un sustantivo (the wind), no de una oración.

answers: Although
blanks.explain: Seguido de oración (it's a small problem) y contraste con la principal.

answers: Therefore
blanks.explain: Consecuencia de "hay que reportarlo": por eso escribe el reporte.

answers: In addition
blanks.explain: Añade una segunda medida (las pantallas contra el viento).

answers: As soon as
blanks.explain: Tiempo: "en cuanto terminen las reparaciones"; va con oración en presente (are done), aunque se refiere al futuro.

answers: finally
blanks.explain: Último punto de la conversación: And finally, …

C2.prompt: Redacta un correo (7 puntos). Escribe a tu cliente, Mr. Lee, un correo de 90 a 130 palabras para avisarle que la prueba hidrostática del tanque T-210 se posterga hasta el lunes porque el camión cisterna se malogró. Debe incluir: (a) un asunto claro; (b) saludo y propósito con I am writing to…; (c) la causa con because, due to o since; (d) la consecuencia con therefore, as a result o consequently; (e) un contraste positivo con however o although; (f) un pedido cortés con Could you please…?; (g) cierre con fórmula y firma.
rubric: (b) saludo y propósito con I am writing to…
(c) la causa con because, due to o since
(d) la consecuencia con therefore, as a result o consequently
(e) un contraste positivo con however o although
(f) un pedido cortés con Could you please…?
C2.model:
Subject: T-210 hydrostatic test – postponed until Monday
Dear Mr. Lee,
I am writing to inform you that the hydrostatic test of Tank T-210 has been postponed until Monday.
The test was delayed because the water truck broke down on the way to the site. As a result, we could not fill the tank this week. However, all the floor welds have already passed the vacuum box test, so the tank is ready.
Could you please confirm that your inspector is available on Monday at 8:00 a.m.?
Please let me know if you have any questions.
Best regards,
Edwin Prieto
Piping Engineer, Coastal Tank Services
